title: Simon 2.7: Poincaré inequality for BV on convex sets (frozen BVPoincare)
statement: (Simon Ch. 2, Lemma 2.7, frozen contract BVPoincare.) For all n ∈ ℕ and θ, δ ∈ (0,1) there is C ≥ 0 such that for every bounded open convex U ⊆ ℝⁿ, R > 0, ξ ∈ U with closedBall(ξ,δR) ⊆ U ⊆ closedBall(ξ,R), every u with IsBVOn U u (U open, u integrable on U, bvVariationOn u U < ∞) and every β ∈ ℝ with ofReal θ·Lⁿ(U) ≤ min(Lⁿ{x ∈ U : β ≤ u(x)}, Lⁿ{x ∈ U : u(x) ≤ β}): ∫⁻_U ‖u(x) − β‖ₑ dx ≤ ofReal(C·R)·bvVariationOn u U.
